coverage_decision: All 11 main-text figures, all 3 main-text tables, and the Figure 11 management workflow are represented. No packet supplements were present. Bibliography is processed separately as a reference queue and is not atomized as primary evidence.
source_integrity_warnings: Publisher disclaimer identifies the evaluated file as an unedited accepted manuscript; source-era production errors may exist.
The manuscript contains at least one imperfect figure cross-reference in the echocardiography discussion.
Figure 11 vasoactive dose ranges do not exactly match Table 3 for epinephrine, norepinephrine, and vasopressin; both contexts are preserved without harmonization.
Table 3 aerosolized iloprost is transcribed as 1–2.5 mg/kg every 2–4 hours; because this is a dose/unit-sensitive clinical statement, it must be independently verified before use.
